setup.title: Set up your help desk
setup.alreadyDone: Setup has already been completed. Sign in with the administrator account.

token.intro: To prove you run this server, paste the one-time setup token. It was printed in the server log when the instance started.
token.label: Setup token
token.hint: Look for "setup token" in the container log
token.wrong: This setup token is not valid. Copy it again from the server log.

admin.reenter: For your security the password is never stored in the browser. Please enter it again.
admin.name: Name

branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB
branding.logoFailed: The logo could not be uploaded ({reason}). You can add it later under Branding.

smtp.intro: Optional: connect an SMTP server so customers receive notifications and can register. You can skip this and configure it later.
smtp.testOk: Test email sent to {to}. Check that it arrived.

error.auth_failed: The server rejected the username or password.
error.tls_mismatch: The security setting does not match the server. Try another port or security mode.
error.connection_refused: The server refused the connection. Check the host and port.
error.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
error.dns: The host name could not be resolved.
error.other: The test email could not be sent.

sso.intro: To let staff and customers sign in with your identity provider (for example Authentik), register these redirect URIs in it, then set the OIDC environment variables and restart.
sso.later: Single sign-on is optional. The administrator you just created can always sign in with email and password.

done.title: Your help desk is ready
done.body: You are signed in as {email}. Next, create teams and categories and invite your agents.
